The plate is a square plate, probably about 22-24 cm across. The food is scrambled eggs with some shredded carrot, covering about 60% of the plate width and piled moderately high.

For mass, the pile is roughly 14 cm by 11 cm and about 2.5 cm thick. That is roughly 250 mL once I allow for air gaps, so about 150-200 g of scrambled egg.

Scrambled eggs run about 150-200 kcal per 100 g once cooking oil is included. At about 170 g, that comes to roughly 280 kcal. The carrot adds a little more, so I'll estimate about 300 kcal.
